mapper.select: SELECT s.item_id, s.image_path, s.slot_type, s.price_exp, o.item_id AS owned_id, CASE WHEN e.item_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS equipped FROM tree_shop_items s LEFT JOIN tree_items o ON o.workspace_id = #{work} AND o.item_id2 = s.item_id LEFT JOIN tree_equipped_items e ON e.workspace_id = #{work} AND e.item_id = o.item_id WHERE s.active_yn = 'Y' AND s.price_exp >= 0 ORDER BY s.item_id

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT balance_exp FROM exp_wallets WHERE workspace_id = #{work}), GREATEST(0, NVL((SELECT total_exp FROM growth_tree WHERE workspace_id = #{work}),0) - NVL((SELECT SUM(paid_exp) FROM tree_items WHERE workspace_id = #{work}),0))) FROM dual
SELECT MAX(exp_log_id) FROM growth_exp_logs WHERE workspace_id = #{work}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exp_transactions(transaction_id, transaction_type, amount_exp, created_at, exp_log_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{type}, #{amount}, SYSDATE, #{log,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.update: MERGE INTO exp_wallets w USING (SELECT CAST(#{work} AS NUMBER(19)) AS workspace_id FROM dual) src ON (w.workspace_id = src.workspace_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET w.balance_exp = GREATEST(0, COALESCE(w.balance_exp, GREATEST(0, #{total} - #{delta} - NVL((SELECT SUM(paid_exp) FROM tree_items WHERE workspace_id = #{work}),0))) + #{delta}), w.exp_log_id = #{log}, w.updated_at = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (workspace_id, balance_exp, exp_log_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{work}, GREATEST(0, #{total} - NVL((SELECT SUM(paid_exp) FROM tree_items WHERE workspace_id = #{work}),0)), #{log}, SYSDATE)
UPDATE exp_wallets SET balance_exp = balance_exp - #{price}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE workspace_id = #{work} AND balance_exp >= #{price}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tree_items(item_id, workspace_id, item_id2, member_id, paid_exp, transaction_id, purchased_at) VALUES(seq_tree_items.NEXTVAL, #{work}, #{item}, #{member}, #{price}, #{tx}, SYSDATE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tree_equipped_items WHERE workspace_id = #{work} AND item_id = #{item}

DELETE FROM tree_equipped_items WHERE workspace_id = #{work} AND item_id IN (SELECT o.item_id FROM tree_items o JOIN tree_shop_items s ON s.item_id = o.item_id2 WHERE o.workspace_id = #{work} AND s.slot_type = #{slot})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tree_equipped_items(tree_equipped_items, workspace_id, item_id, member_id, equipped_at) VALUES(seq_tree_equipped_items.NEXTVAL, #{work}, #{owned}, #{member}, SYSDATE)
